root_cause: Micromodal's click listener treats any click on an element with data-micromodal-close (including the overlay) as a request to close the modal, without checking if the click originated from inside the modal content. When a checkbox is activated via Space, a click event bubbles up to the overlay, causing the modal to close prematurely and preventing the checkbox toggle.
repair_strategy: Modify the onClick handler to ignore overlay clicks when the event target is not the overlay itself (i.e., the click came from inside the modal). Close button clicks remain unaffected because their target is the close button, not the overlay.
expected_accessibility_effect: Pressing Space on a checkbox inside the modal will now toggle the checkbox without closing the modal, preserving keyboard operability and maintaining visible focus within the dialog, satisfying WCAG 2.1.1 (Keyboard) and 2.4.3 (Focus Order).
functional_risks: Potential impact if the modal structure changes and the overlay lacks the 'modal__overlay' class, though this is internal to the component.
Programmatic clicks on the overlay from scripts will still close the modal as intended.
No change to ESC or Tab key handling.
verification_requirements: Verify that pressing Space on the weekly checkbox toggles its state and leaves the modal open (aria-hidden false).
Verify that clicking the modal backdrop still closes the modal.
Verify that clicking the close button (×) still closes the modal.
Ensure focus returns to the opener after closing via backdrop or button.
Ensure no regression in ESC and Tab key handling.
